post_exposure_label: Post-exposure: designed after sc30-sc54 primary results observed. All values labeled 'observed reconstructed concurrent cabinet power'.
status: STUB — requires raw job telemetry parquet
instructions: To complete this audit: (1) Load the full job telemetry with start_time, end_time, mean_power_kW, n_nodes, cabinet columns. (2) For each hourly bin and each cabinet, sum the power contributions of all jobs overlapping that bin. (3) Record: n_bins_with_jobs per cabinet, contiguous_blocks, support_hours, concurrent_job_distribution, concurrent_node_distribution. (4) Compute legacy_exceedance_fraction per cabinet (Task E). (5) Compute F2 and F3 P99 estimates per cabinet (Task F). All outputs must use the label 'observed reconstructed concurrent cabinet power'.
